authorityBoundary: The official Recent Fiscal Court Ordinances page reviewed on 2026-10-03 lists enacted 2026 ordinances through Ordinance 2026-15, posted 2026-09-23. It shows targeted zoning text amendments in Ordinances 2026-01 and 2026-02, but no listed enactment identified as the comprehensive 2026 Zoning Ordinance Update/rewrite and no listed enactment identifying Article 34 sign-rule replacement. This is bounded to the official enacted-ordinances notice page as reviewed; it does not prove that no later action can occur or that every codified ordinance is represented by this temporary notice page.
adoptedSignAuthority: Continue using the separately archived adopted Boone County Zoning Regulations Article 34 as sign-regulation authority unless reviewed official adoption/effective-date evidence establishes replacement text.
nextLogicalAuthorityTarget: Inspect the official American Legal Boone County Code update/codification metadata and current adopted zoning-regulation source for any post-2026-15 enactment or codified Article 34 replacement; otherwise recheck Fiscal Court after the October 6 meeting.
